_howToRaise: First-load JS budgets in kB (gzip, 1 kB = 1000 B), checked by `pnpm check:bundle` after `pnpm build` (scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs). A route uses `routes[path]` if listed, else `default`. Over budget? First try to shrink it (dynamic import, move code to a server component, drop a dependency). To raise a budget deliberately, edit only that route's number here in the same PR as the growth, and say why in the PR description; do not raise `default` to cover one heavy route. To re-baseline everything after a planned change: `pnpm build && pnpm check:bundle --write` (measured size + 10% headroom; this note is kept).
